title: Reduce telemetry formatter flat exports
summary: Removed the telemetry-only formatPercent and formatMemoryMb flat formatter aliases while preserving telemetry rendering through mediaPipelineFormatters.
reason: WebView flat-export cleanup should reduce high-confidence transitional globals without changing backend-owned media or mutation behavior. Telemetry is the only consumer of these two formatter aliases, and formatters.js already exposes them through mediaPipelineFormatters.
behavior_before: formatters.js exported formatPercent and formatMemoryMb as flat window aliases, and telemetryView.js consumed those helpers as ambient globals.
behavior_after: telemetryView.js binds formatPercent and formatMemoryMb from window.mediaPipelineFormatters with local fallbacks, while formatters.js no longer publishes those two flat aliases. Remaining settings/path/list formatter flat aliases stay unchanged.
rollback_plan: Restore window.formatPercent and window.formatMemoryMb assignments in formatters.js, switch telemetryView.js back to ambient formatter globals, regenerate the WebView public contract/global export inventory/summaries, and rerun the targeted telemetry validation ladder.
notes:
Remove telemetry-only formatter flat aliases while retaining mediaPipelineFormatters namespace members.
Read telemetry percent and memory formatters from mediaPipelineFormatters namespace.
Assert telemetry formatter flat aliases stay removed and telemetry binds namespace helpers.
Pin telemetry namespace formatter wiring in static WebView checks.
Regenerate WebView public contract after telemetry formatter alias cleanup.
Sync flat export inventory after removing telemetry formatter aliases.
Refresh generated summary after telemetry formatter flat-export cleanup.
This is frontend/read-only telemetry formatting cleanup only; no backend routes, command journal behavior, confirmations, source-media access, pending-publish policy, settings persistence, or mutation paths changed.
